digest.component_or_area: container plan-review attestation and scope inheritance
propositions: A live child declared none is neutral and contributes no paths to parent inheritance, unlike undeclared children which poison sibling path declarations
A live undeclared child poisons container child-path inheritance and prevents all-none classification, while closed children are always ignored

Container scope classification must follow exact precedence: own/cited/inherited paths yield paths scope; explicit parent none yields none; all-live-children-none promotes undeclared parent to none; otherwise unscoped
Plan-review signing must compute child impact once from full direct-child states and apply the same tri-state result for both dependency hashing and all-none classification
Cheap resign must preserve child-derived signed scope using immutable relation snapshot without network reads and structured refusal on missing child state
P9 must count only live undeclared children as poisoners, pass declared-none leaves and all-declared containers, and advise poisoners with both path-declaration and --none remedies
